title: Dual Reflection Groups from Solutions to the Yang--Baxter Equation
summary: Suppose that $r: X^2 \to X^2$ is a nondegenerate, involutive solution to the set-theoretic Yang--Baxter equation. To this data, we can associate an Artin--Schelter regular algebra $A$ and an infinite family of groups $G_k$, where $k \geqslant 1$. For each $k$, we show that $G_k$ is a dual reflection group for $A$, in the sense the component of $A$ graded by $1_{G_k}$ is again Artin--Schelter regular.
